submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE: 0.0342% at Sb=0.353. The EQE rises steeply from Sb-rich to Pb-rich compositions (0.85: ~0, 0.68: 0.00014, 0.51: 0.00086), peaks near Sb≈0.35 and drops at Sb=0.28 (0.0077). XRD at 0.28, 0.35 and 0.41 shows the same cubic pyrochlore-like phase, with a lattice that shrinks as Sb increases, plus Pt substrate peaks. That points to a solid solution whose activity peaks around Sb≈0.33–0.38.
